rules.title: Los Angeles RSO security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance must pay tenants interest on security deposits at a rate set annually by the City, paid monthly or yearly as a direct payment or rent credit. Landlords must notify tenants in writing of the chosen payment method.
rules.key_value: Annual City-set rate (e.g., 4.320% for calendar year 2025); paid monthly or annually
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units in the City of Los Angeles subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LARSO).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to units subject to LARSO; document does not state LARSO coverage criteria.

rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be raised as a defense in eviction proceedings and may result in loss of eviction cases.
rules.quoted_span: Interest shall begin accruing on November 1, 1990, on a monthly basis. A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant s rent. The landlord shall choose between these two methods of payment and notify the tenant in writing of his or her choice.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source (landlord association article posted May 2025); rate table updated 5/21/25 and does not show 2026 rate. Effective date reflects interest accrual start date stated in the quoted code text.
